alt_small.rule: SMALL with the game's best TD at 45% or more, whichever team, instead of the pick's team's first

chosen.objective: the highest SMALL hit rate (won / (won + lost)) among the pairs that build a SMALL ticket in at least 25% of 2014-2019's games; ties to the larger coverage, then the lower CONFIDENT, then the lower TD_FLOOR

est_erratum: Correction, found after the rule was fixed: the est. payout is not an upper bound. A bet builder prices legs that go together below the product of the singles, but can price legs that pull against each other above it (a touchdown on one team beside the other team's result, or beside the under), and Stake's single prices are not the books' consensus - so the est. payout, and the live return read at it, is an estimate that Stake's quote can beat or fall short of.

grid.note: every pair of the grid, per period; only the DEV figures chose, and only by the objective

inputs.SPREAD: closing spread_line and its prices, games.csv.gz, proportional no-vig
inputs.TD: nfl_td walk-forward prob (season S fitted on seasons before S), shipped usage groups only; graded on box-score rushing + receiving TDs
inputs.TOTAL: closing total_line and its prices, games.csv.gz, proportional no-vig
inputs.WIN: nfl_model walk-forward blend_prob (season S fitted on seasons before S)
inputs.pick: nfl_predict's pick of the same blend: the home side at P(home) 0.5 or more
inputs.rookie: no player_games row in an earlier season

known_bias: In the backtest a TD candidate is a player who took a snap, so the replay knows who was active. Live, a pick who does not play is voided and the ticket is graded on its other legs.
no_edge: Nothing here claims an edge. The market is hard to beat, and parlays multiply the margin of every leg; these tickets are the legs the engine rates most likely to land, not bets it rates profitable.
no_edge_v2: Nothing here claims an edge. Narrowing to likely legs raises the hit rate and lowers the payout; the market prices both. These are the legs the engine rates most likely to land, not bets it rates profitable.
payout_basis: est. - the product of the legs' consensus single prices; Stake's bet builder prices correlated legs below it, so it is an upper bound on what Stake pays
